test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A is 40% more efficient than B. If B finishes a work in 14 days, then in how many days will A finish the same work?
solution:
**Formula:**

Efficiency = Time taken to complete total work ÷ Time taken to complete work individually

**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of B be 1

According to the question-

⇒ Efficiency of A = 1 + 0.4 = 1.4

∴ Time taken by A to complete the work = 14 ÷ 1.4 = 10 days

**A takes 10 days to complete the work.**
